input.overview: The io-shop stopped sending its measurements to the monitoring system, and this has gone on for {duration}. Customers using the shop saw nothing wrong. Only the shop's own metrics stopped arriving. It happened because a configuration change renamed the port the shop uses to publish its measurements. The monitoring system was still looking for the old name, so it could no longer find the shop and stopped collecting its measurements. Argus estimates the cost in lost takings at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. The problem is not yet fixed. Argus identified a suspected cause but chose not to act on it, because the only way to test it would be to undo a change that was made on purpose. Instead, Argus proposed a fix and opened it as a draft. That fix has not been applied yet, so the shop's measurements are still not being collected.
